Message:
s390/kvm: Stop using gmap_{en,dis}able()

Stop using gmap_enable(), gmap_disable(), gmap_get_enabled().

The correct guest ASCE is passed as a parameter of sie64a(), there is
no need to save the current gmap in lowcore.
